issues: 原版只有一只居中的暗色胶囊，上下大半画面是空的黑底
声纹条细、灰白低对比，1080p 下起伏读得出但没有视觉重量
全片没有任何'说了什么'的信息，说/停只能靠波形猜
提交后只是箭头换对勾，没有'发出去了'的落点，结尾帧不成海报
changes: look = sand（米色 · 赤陶）：从 raycast 暗场玻璃改成午后暖光亮场，虚构语音助手 Juniper，暖白实底胶囊 + 两层落地影 + 随音量亮灭的地面暖光
加 92px 粗体实时转写：每个词在它那一拍的音节起点由虚到实升起，刚说出的词赤陶色、几帧后沉成墨色，停顿段尾光标闪烁——说/停从字和波形两处同时读得到
声纹机制保留（64 条、1.6 帧/采样滚动、说停包络 × 音节噪声 × 中部权重），条改赤陶纵向渐变、越旧越淡，静默点线用中性弱色；麦克风钮赤陶底 + 随包络外扩两层呼吸环
提交：按钮压缩回弹、波形 12f 塌缩、箭头上飞对勾落入，转写整体上移缩到 0.72 收进赤陶消息气泡（墨字 → 白字），下方升起 'Sent to Juniper · 0:03'，胶囊退回待机
开场加 'Ask Juniper anything…' 提示语、计时器 0:00 起跳，时长 150f → 172f，尾段 20f 对话海报 hold
issuesEn: The original was a single dark capsule in the middle with most of the frame empty black
Thin, low-contrast grey-white bars: the rhythm read at 1080p but had no visual weight
Nothing showed what was being said, so talk and pause could only be guessed from the waveform
Submitting just swapped an arrow for a check, with no 'it was sent' landing and no poster-like end frame
changesEn: Look = sand (beige, terracotta): from a Raycast-style dark glass to warm afternoon light for a fictional voice assistant, Juniper, with a warm-white solid capsule, two-layer floor shadow and a warm floor glow that follows the level

Added a 92px bold live transcript: each word rises from blur to sharp at its syllable onset, fresh words are terracotta and sink to ink a few frames later, and a caret blinks through the pause, so talk and pause read from both text and waveform

The waveform mechanics are kept (64 bars, 1.6 frames per sample scroll, talk/pause envelope × syllable noise × centre weight); bars are now a terracotta vertical gradient fading with age, silence dots are neutral, and the terracotta mic button has two breathing rings that grow with the envelope

Submit: the button compresses and rebounds, the waveform collapses in 12f, the arrow flies up and a check drops in, and the transcript moves up, scales to 0.72 and settles into a terracotta message bubble (ink → white) with 'Sent to Juniper · 0:03' rising below while the capsule returns to idle
Opens with an 'Ask Juniper anything…' prompt and a 0:00 timer; duration 150f → 172f with a 20f conversation-poster hold
